OmniControl Suite v8.13.4 - Complete Bloat Removal & Lightweight Overhaul:
- Removed 13 unusable/placebo cards across Gaming, Network, and System tabs (Ping test, TCP registry, SMART drive, DDA, DWM bypass, Power budget churn).
- Streamlined Gaming & GPU to 6 essential hardware tools (OptiRouter AI, Game Focus EcoQoS, UXTU Safeguard, OEM Bloatware Neutralizer, NVAPI Sliders, GPU Telemetry).
- Streamlined System Tools to Storage/Shader Cleaner and Startup Manager.
- Fixed all background CPU thread allocation for ultra-lightweight <0.1% idle operation.
